text: What is etiquette? It is simply due respect to one's elders. If I respect the parents, the son will be pleased; if I respect the elder brothers, the younger ones will be pleased; and if I respect the sovereign, all the ministers will be pleased.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
speaker: Confucius
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter XII, Amplification of the Important Doctrine
